title.narrative: Programa de Desarrollo Pesquero y Acuicola Sustentable
Sustainable Fishery Development Program

description.narrative: El programa contribuye a la gestin sustentable del recurso pesquero en la Argentina. Sus objetivos son: (i) mejorar las capacidades de investigacin, planificacin, administracin, control y fiscalizacin de la gestin de los recursos pesqueros martimos con enfoque ecosistmico; y (ii) apoyar el desarrollo de la acuicultura.

This Program aims toward the sustainable management of fisheries resources in Argentina. Its objectives are: (i) improve capabilities of research, planning, administration, control and fiscalization of marine fishery resources with an ecosistemic approach; and (ii) support acuaculture development.
